p_mc_min_note: the Monte Carlo grid floor: a sampled p-value can fall below p_orbit_floor through noise, so the two are never written as one bound
boundary_tie_note: a pair whose orbit floor equals the first Holm threshold exactly. Holm rejects at p <= threshold, so it is reachable; the legacy_float count is the same number with such ties removed, which is what a floating log-gamma orbit size produced before this was corrected
p_orbit_floor_note: 1 / Omega is never zero; the float column saturates to 0 below about 1e-308, so p_orbit_floor_log10 is the field to read and to publish
